description:
Upgrade towel storage with an assorted free standing accessorie towel stand featuring 4 pivoting swing arms and solid brass construction in Flat Troll Blue, which presents a distinctive, muted blue-gray tone that adds artistic character to contemporary bathroom designs. The freestanding design needs no wall mounting, making it easy to place where you need it in the bathroom.

Highlights:
- Flat Troll Blue creates a distinctive focal point
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping
- Felt pad helps protect floors and countertops from scratches
- Offered in multiple designer finish options, including statement colors

Specs:
- Type: Floor standing towel stand with swing arms
- Mounting: Freestanding
- Material: Brass
- Overall size: 49-Inch H x 12-Inch L x 10.5-Inch W
